title: A live child is read from the whole process table and the load line takes the 60 s orphan rule
goal: mon_sessions finds a process's live child among every process of the table, not only listed ones (cwd in the clone), so a child with another or unreadable cwd gives with a live child; the load line of mon_status counts orphans by the same 60 s rule as the Sessions line.

run:
import sys,time;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_procs,mon_base,mon_sessions,mon_status
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve();start=time.time()-600
tab={900001:(1,start,'node'),900002:(900001,start,'sleep')}
bl_procs.process_table=lambda *a,**k:tab
bl_procs.cwd_map=lambda *a,**k:({900001:str(root),900002:'/nonexistent-elsewhere'},None)
data=mon_sessions.collect(mon_base.Ctx(root))
mine=[p for p in data['procs'] if p['pid']==900001]
snap={'taken':'2026-11-09T10:00:00Z','panels':{'host':{'state':'ok','data':{'load':[1.0,1.0,1.0],'cores':8}},'sessions':{'state':'ok','data':{'procs':[{'pid':5,'age_s':30,'class':'orphan','checkout':'.'}]}}}}
text=' '.join(mon_status.answer(snap,'load')['lines'])
sys.exit(0 if mine and mine[0].get('live_child') and ' 0 of them orphan' in text else 1)
